p2_raw.answer: To receive an Academic Scholarship equivalent to 10% of the Tuition Fee in SCSET, you need a CGPA of 8.0 and above, provided you are among the top 10% performers in your programme and meet other conditions.
p2_raw.quote: Performance Criteria: A student securing a CGPA of 8.5 and above in programmes offered under the School of Artificial Intelligence, and 8.0 and above in programmes offered under other Schools, on a scale of 10, shall be eligible to receive an Academic Scholarship equivalent to 10% of the Tuition Fee, as per the review cycles stated above, provided that the student is among the top 10% performers in the respective programme.
